lines.trans: Good morning! All the way upstairs it smells wonderful like warm cinnamon!
Good morning, Madam Helga! My cinnamon rolls are just coming out of the oven.
Sit right down by the sunny window! No rush this morning!
Actually I only wanted to ask why the water tap in the bathroom was so chilly.

words.gram: definite article (masc. nom. sg. / fem. dat.-gen. sg.)

lines.trans: Chilly? Ah yes! Our old pipes in the neighbourhood stretch slowly first thing in the morning!
Drink hot tea for ten minutes first and eat a cinnamon roll!
Well, nobody wise says no to warm cinnamon pastry at seven in the morning.
Excellent choice! Would you like honey or apple jam on the side?

words.gloss: with it, on the side, in addition

lines.trans: Just a little butter, thank you. Why do you keep looking at your watch?
Me? Oh, I simply love punctuality! Seven fourteen is a lovely minute!
Look through the courtyard window, Martin, someone just ran through the gate!
Saved! Excuse me a moment, madam, enjoy the hot tea!
